$comment: A deterministic demo skill: an event-driven agent workflow (observe, classify, assert, decide, execute virtually) that returns an auditable evidence chain. Pushed with `gadgets push`, never bundled.
title: Breakout Workflow
description: Deterministic breakout/breakdown agent workflow over a bar series: classifies the latest bar, checks risk assertions, decides, fills virtually, and returns an evidence chain. Can run on a schedule, with an optional model review of runs that acted. Bound to a trading lab study variant, it runs that variant's cycles and records its decisions with the lab, which books any fill.

REVIEW_MODEL.title: Review model
REVIEW_MODEL.description: Optional. Writes a short reviewer note on scheduled runs that bought, sold or were blocked; never makes decisions.

LAB_VARIANT.title: Study variant
LAB_VARIANT.description: Optional. A trading lab study variant this workflow runs: each cycle it reads the bars and portfolio, decides, and records the run; the lab books any fill.
